messages.author: 722521532a54784f
messages.subject: function to convert dartR object to genlight?
parts:
Hi,
I need to convert a dartR object to a genlight object as I want to use the PCA plotting function from an old dartR package version that allows me to add to each dots the individual label (label by individuals)

Is there any function allowing this conversion?

Thank you!
Gabriella

messages.author: b3d929c6746ca81a
messages.subject: Re: [dartR] function to convert dartR object to genlight?
parts:
class(gl) <- “genlight”
 Make sure you use straight quotes
---------
